sources.title: LLNL SCR 3.1.0 — Integrate SCR
sources.publisher: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory / SCR project
sources.published: 3.1.0 documentation; page publication date not stated
sources.locator: Checkpoint: SCR_Complete_output(valid); Restart with SCR: SCR_Have_restart, SCR_Start_restart, SCR_Complete_restart
sources.scope: Completion/validity and available checkpoint restart. The atlas atomic commit delay, deterministic faults and all numerical values are synthetic.

sources.title: DOE/LBNL — Data Center Metering and Resource Guide
sources.publisher: US Department of Energy / Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory
sources.locator: Section 2.1, Power Usage Effectiveness; section 3.2, Energy vs. Power
sources.scope: Nested facility/IT energy boundary and distinction between power and energy. The fixed PUE and phase powers in H7 are not measured data.

claims.title: Restart requires a valid available checkpoint
claims.statement: SCR defines checkpoint completion and validity, and provides an API to restart from available checkpoint state.
claims.scope: Software checkpoint validity; H7 uses a simpler synthetic atomic-commit rule.
claims.limitations: No vendor hardware fault rate, storage durability guarantee or universally optimal checkpoint policy is inferred.

claims.title: Facility and IT energy are distinct nested boundaries
claims.statement: PUE compares facility energy with IT equipment energy; power is an energy rate.
claims.denominator: IT equipment energy over the same observation interval
claims.scope: The example uses a constant synthetic ratio consistently over all phases.
claims.limitations: The chosen 1.25 is not an observed annual or fleet PUE, and PUE is not a productivity metric.

syntheticCalculations.basis: Included executable operating-hall model; independently derived timeline and energy arithmetic
